visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Scene opens in a brightly lit indoor living/dining area with light wood floors. An elderly man with grey hair, wearing a grey t-shirt and black puffer vest, stands by a dark grey sliding door, gesturing emphatically with his hands. An orange and white tabby cat stands near a light wood dining table with two chairs. (2) Close-up shot of the cat looking towards the camera and then turning its head away. The setting is the same indoor dining area with a glass-topped table. (3) The man continues to gesture at the doorway, pointing his finger and shaking his hand to indicate a prohibition. The cat walks around the legs of the table. (4) Transition to the interior of a car during the day. The elderly man is seen from the side in the driver's seat, wearing glasses and a grey shirt. He is talking and gesturing with one hand while driving. The background through the window shows moving trees and buildings. (5) Back in the house, the cat sits on the wooden floor facing a closed dark brown door. It looks up at the door repeatedly. (6) The cat attempts to paw at the gap in the door and sticks its head into the opening. (7) The cat finally walks through the open doorway into a bedroom. The lower half of the man, wearing a striped shirt and dark shorts, is visible. (8) Close-up of a pink handheld vacuum cleaner being turned on while resting on a floral patterned bedspread. A hand is seen pressing the power button. (9) The man uses the pink vacuum with a long attachment to clean under a dark wooden cabinet on the floor. (10) The man holds the pink vacuum upright like a staff, looking into the camera and speaking. He is wearing a yellow polo shirt and glasses. (11) Final scene shows the man lying in bed under a green duvet, and then the cat sitting patiently outside the doorway in the hallway.
